title: Aligning a grid's items inside their cells
summary: justify-items and align-items position each item inside its own cell, separate from the track sizes.
explanation: Columns size to their widest item here (auto), so the grid has no spare room to fill. justify-items: start then places each item at the left of its own cell, instead of stretching it across the cell.
align-items: center moves items to the middle of their row vertically. Together they set the default for every child, and a single child can still override them with justify-self or align-self.
tryThis: Change justify-items to stretch: every item fills its cell and the text lines up at the left edge of each.
Change align-items to end: the short items drop to the bottom of their row.
Set grid-template-columns to 1fr 1fr 1fr: the columns now share the width and the justify-items change is easier to see.
